name: Nexus Surgical and Medicare Limited
about: Nexus Surgical and Medicare Limited trades in medical supplies in India. The company offers surgical and pharmaceutical products; and various sizes of disposal syringes and pouches for storage of sterilized equipment and materials. Nexus Surgical and Medicare Limited was formerly known as Nexus Commodities and Technologies Limited and changed its name to Nexus Surgical and Medicare Limited in August 2020. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Palghar, India.
